theses.statement: At 18:30, Samuel Agbede will present a talk on retrieval for AI agents, demonstrating hybrid search, filtering, incremental updates, and context selection with a Redis retail agent, exploring relevance, freshness, conflicting sources, and context issues.

At 19:00, Evangelos Resvanis will present a talk on memory for AI agents, demonstrating memory scoping, retrieval, corrections, retiring assumptions, and testing consistency without context expansion, covering working and long-term memory separation.
